FX-BULGE-024.says: Antialiasing High on FX-BULGE-004 (radius 6, height 1): each pixel the mean of four reads a quarter pixel either way, so the swollen stripes' edges come out softer; every pixel whose four points are all past the circle, the drawing's two ends among them, is kept exactly.

FX-BULGE-025.says: Antialiasing High on FX-BULGE-007 (radius 6, height -4), the hard pinch where one read per pixel jumps furthest: the four reads smooth it.

FX-BULGE-027.says: Antialiasing High at height 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-BULGE-028.says: Pin All Edges on FX-BULGE-001 (radius 50, height 1, every pixel in reach): the border pixels, rows 0 and 9 and columns 0 and 15, are kept exactly, and the pull fades in over the 2.5 pixels inside them, so the empty top and bottom rows and the right-hand column stay empty.

FX-BULGE-029.says: Pin All Edges on FX-BULGE-004 (radius 6): the circle reaches the top and bottom rows, which are kept; rows 1 and 8 swell less; columns 0, 1, 14 and 15, out of reach, are kept as before.

FX-BULGE-030.says: Pin All Edges and Antialiasing High together on FX-BULGE-001: the border kept, the inside swollen and smoothed.

FX-BULGE-031.says: FX-BULGE-028 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; the pinned edges are the drawing's own, and the three columns left of it stay empty.

FX-BULGE-032.says: Pin All Edges written off: FX-BULGE-001 exactly.

FX-BULGE-033.says: Antialiasing written "medium". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BULGE-034.says: Pin All Edges written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
